data.title: Wanmei Zhi Cheng: Mama
data.synopsis:
A wood monster conceives a child covered in roots, ugly and out of control. The monster finds a liquid named Perfect, feeds it, and sculpts the child into a human form, gradually transforming it into the perfect being. This grotesque stop-motion animation depicts the subtexts of social ideology, childbirth and parenting.

(Source: IMDB)

data.title: Yangguang Shai Pigu
data.synopsis:
An ordinary night in an ordinary family. The child who is afraid of the dark seems to have grown up a bit, and the parents who are busy with their livelihood seem to be happier. Life is mostly made up of such small and insignificant changes, slowly forming our lives.

(Source: Animated Film Box)
